record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, weaken the existing training-frequency history feature by changing its inverse-log-frequency exponent from -0.25 to -0.125. Retain mean-one normalization, clipping to [0.75,1.25], unseen-item scale 1 and padding scale 0. Stronger attenuation regressed; a milder correction may preserve informative common items while reducing their dominance. Use training counts only and checkpoint the scales. Keep embedding design, topology, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed.
